answer: Sonnet-Kernel Seal: each epoch, an agent submits a 14-line sonnet whose tokens decode a unique kernel trace from a deterministic VM seeded by the willow Merkle root of prior state plus the agent’s public key. Validators replay the VM and enforce canonical constrained decoding. The answer cannot be copied because the seed binds key and history. A sybil pays one independent VM trace and one valid sonnet per identity, making mass identities linear in CPU and decoding cost.
